⇒ gate **CLOSED**. This is a **product** card — an author writes a map style, nothing refuses it, and the map renders on the public demo tiles. Clause 2: 「能跑但出错 ⇒ P2」; clause 4: ⛔ 永不静默丢弃.

### 1. ⭐ Re-measured at source — the card says 「both hand-listed flatteners」; there are THREE flatteners and only TWO are hand-listed

Read on objectui `origin/main` in this act:

| site | shape |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:1565` | the declaration — `style: z.string().optional().describe('MapLibre style URL/spec (overrides the public demo default)')` |
| `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:67` | `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` — **hand-listed** |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:109` | `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` — **hand-listed** |
| `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:138` | ⭐ `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS = (Object.keys(ObjectMapConfigSchema.shape) …).filter(…)` — **DERIVED** |

⇒ the map's own flattener already derives from the schema. The two that drop `style` are the **list-view** and **object-view** paths, and the file comments in both say so of themselves: 「`object-map`'s own `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` in `ObjectMap.tsx` DOES derive from …」.

### 2. ⭐⭐ The question the dispatch turns on, which the card does not ask

Both hand-listed sites **already carry a pin** that compares the list against the declaration:

```
packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.mapFlatten.test.tsx:155   expect([...FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS].sort()).toEqual(declared);
packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.mapFlatten.test.tsx:190  expect([...FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS].sort()).toEqual(declared);
```

⇒ **those pins pass today while `style` is dropped.** So `declared` must itself be computed in a way that excludes `style` — the card names `Omit<ObjectMapConfig,'style'>` as the type doing it. ⇒ ⭐ this is ⛔ not 「a key was forgotten」; it is **a pin measuring against a set narrowed to match the bug**. Whoever fixes the flattener without fixing that must explain why the pin was green, or it goes green again for the same wrong reason.

### 3. In-flight and file face

⛔ Zero cards in flight for this seat at claim time; PRs objectui#9988 and objectui#9995 merged. Faces of the two cards claimed beside this one: objectui#9884 → `packages/plugin-form`, objectui#9925 → `packages/plugin-kanban` · `plugin-timeline` · `plugin-detail`. ⛔ Disjoint from this one.

```
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx
packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/**
packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/**
.changeset/*
```

⚠️ `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` is **read-only** here — it is the declaration being conformed to, ⛔ not a file to edit. `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` is **read-only** too: its flattener already derives, and it is the ⭐ **worked example** of the shape the other two should reach.

Next: dispatch to one `os-dev`, one worktree.

PR objectui#9999 merged 2026-09-19T09:55:24Z as `3a54c3989`. Healthy merge, ⛔ not an
ejection: `removed_from_merge_queue` and `merged` one second apart.

## Verified BY CONTENT on merged `origin/main`, ⛔ not by sha and ⛔ not by ancestry

| reading | before `dc4924655` | after `3a54c3989` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING` in `ListView.tsx` + `ObjectView.tsx` | 0 | **6** |
| `mapStyle` in the same two renderers | 0 | **12** |
| **CONTROL** — `latitudeField` in the same two renderers | **7** | **7** |
| **CONTROL** — `getMapConfig` in `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` | **10** | **10** |

Both controls are **unmoved on both refs**: the instrument is live, so the two movements are
readings. An authored `map: { style }` now reaches the renderer under the flat spelling
`getMapConfig` actually reads, and the top-level `style` namespace — the base face's inline CSS,
which objectui#5177 fenced — is still never written.

### ⭐ A correction to this seat's own expectation, published because it was wrong

This seat expected the narrowing `declared.filter((key) => key !== 'style')` to go to **0** — the
comparison set that had been narrowed by the very key the whitelist was missing. Measured, it went
**2 → 6**. Reading the diff rather than trusting the expectation: the dev **kept** the old narrowing,
named it, and built two CONTROLS out of it —

- `preFixFlatten()` reproduces the pre-fix flattener, and the new relation assertion is run against
  it: `expect(undeliveredKeys(preFixProduct)).toEqual(['style'])` — ⭐ the one dropped key **named**,
  not merely a non-empty set, plus an explicit `.toThrow()` leg proving the instrument can fail;
- a second control reproduces the narrowed set and asserts the hand list no longer equals it, so the
  reason the OLD pin was green is preserved as a readable fact rather than deleted.

⇒ the 2 → 6 is the old comparison **promoted to a lit control**, which is a better shape than the
deletion this seat had in mind. The pin now asserts the RELATION 「every declared key is delivered」
against the whole declaration, with `expect(declared).toContain('style')` guarding its own
non-vacuity.

### ⭐ ⛔ No stale-prose residue this time

The retired name `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` still reads **8** repo-wide, and all eight are correct:
`packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:138` is a **different, live** constant — `ObjectMap`'s own,
genuinely DERIVED from `ObjectMapConfigSchema.shape` — plus its one use at `:336`, two docblocks in
the renamed renderers that point AT that constant, and three `CHANGELOG.md` entries, which are
historical records and ⛔ never retroactively rewritten. ⇒ unlike PR objectui#10001, this rename
leaves nothing citing a spelling that no longer exists.

## The landing this card had to survive

⚠️ Worth keeping on the record: this PR was **ejected from the merge queue** at
2026-09-19T08:26:16Z over a failure in neither its diff nor its base — the
`upstream-port-parity-wiring` gate, root-caused and filed as **objectui#10006** (`--list` truncated
by `process.exit` on a pipe, so the listing is cut at a point that depends on runner load). The one
permitted re-run came back green on the same tree, which is the confirmation. ⛔ No test was skipped,
disabled or quarantined, and ⛔ nothing in this PR changed to route around it.
